Definition: from G2779 and οὖρος (a warden); a garden-keeper, i.e. gardener:--gardener.
BiblicalUsage: Kepouros means a gardener, the keeper of a garden. John 20:15 says Mary, supposing him to be the gardener, asked Jesus where he had laid the Lord's body.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Mary mistook the risen Lord for the gardener because he was the gardener, the one tending the new garden.
